title: RocketRide server settings
description: Optional provider keys for LLM nodes. The document pipelines (doc-to-text, redact-pii) and the MCP tools for building and validating pipelines work without any keys. Add one key to unlock summarize, extract-data, ask and agent. Keys are stored encrypted and passed to the engine as environment variables; they never leave your run.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Model id the ready-made LLM pipelines use when a request does not name one, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or claude-haiku-4-5. Leave empty for the provider node's default.

llmBaseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL
llmBaseUrl.description: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, Ollama, ...), e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

llmModel.title: Model for that endpoint
llmModel.description: Exact model id at that endpoint.

additionalEnv.title: Other node credentials
additionalEnv.description: Any other ROCKETRIDE_* variables your pipelines reference, e.g. {"ROCKETRIDE_QDRANT_HOST": "...", "ROCKETRIDE_COHERE_KEY": "..."}. Names must start with ROCKETRIDE_.

warmFeaturedPipelines.title: Pre-warm document pipelines
warmFeaturedPipelines.description: Start the doc-to-text and redact-pii pipelines when the server boots, so the first request is fast.

verboseLogging.title: Verbose engine logs
verboseLogging.description: Run the engine with --verbose for debugging.
